name: component-card-evidence
goal: Component cards show only screenshots, neutral names and clickable consumers; incomplete visual coverage blocks verification and handoff.

evidence: The prior catalog loop handed off before full verification. Historical 05c9384 has failed ledger/reasons gates; Account Menu and Model Cards have no scenarios or screenshots. Cards also expose unwanted summaries, contains and status fields.

Standard catalog SSR and browser tests accepted extra metadata and explicit gaps but did not assert completion blocks for absent component preview bindings. Strengthen existing catalog, usage and preview-binding checks; keep negative evidence honesty tests.

At e1593dcf the committed standard tests fail: component.cards retain extra metadata, usage links are missing, and registryGate accepts a component with no preview. Browser checkpoints captured at three widths.

Reuse EntityLink for three distinct consumers, remove card-only metadata, keep provenance in the image link tooltip, rename Model Cards without changing identity, and reject active component manifests without a required own screenshot preview.

Simplified cards to screenshots, neutral titles and three distinct consumer links. Screenshot origin remains in the link tooltip. Registry checks now reject active components without required preview bindings; local and generated guidance require real visual evidence and repaired failure gates.
At 3be78b44, sealed d0064517 passes the unchanged standard tests and all three browser widths; paired red 83e27c20 at e1593dcf fails the missing-preview assertion and compact-card assertions.

The unchanged memoryTree registry fixture rejects an active component without a preview, accepts its own required screenshot binding, and exempts retired/nonvisual units. Sealed red replays the original accepting behavior; sealed green proves rejection.
